about: JSON nested deeper than SourceBounds.jsonDepth, 32 levels, the outermost object being level 1 (chapter 1 § 1.7). A format nests arrays of arrays. Invalid: formats/nested_points.json opens an object at level 33. Valid: its deepest object is at level 32.
